name: Emergency Stop Activation Guard
description: When the safety scanner detects an intruder (b_intruder=1), the emergency stop must activate and bring the robot to rest within 0.5 s. Guarded UPR: the stop torque ramp applies only when b_intruder=1.

elements.name: Intruder Detection Flag
elements.description: Binary safety flag: 0=safe zone clear, 1=intruder detected by safety laser scanner.

uncertainty.source: Safety laser scanner (Sick S300) detection logic

elements.name: Maximum Stop Time
elements.description: IEC 60204-1 stop category 0: maximum time to reach zero velocity

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(τ) = 0 if b_intruder=1, else τ; guard activates zero-torque command when intruder flag set
consistency_relations.upr_description: Guarded UPR: emergency stop logic applies only when intruder flag b_intruder=1 is active.
